column10: Day 1 : Pickup from Srinagar + Local Sightseeing%Upon arrival at Srinagar airport, our representative will meet you and transfer you to your hotel. After freshening up, embark on a local tour of Mughal Gardens, including Nishant, Shalimar, Cheshmashahi, Pari Mahal, Dal Lake, and the famous Shankrancharya temple. Enjoy dinner and an overnight stay at the hotel.
column11: Day 2 : Srinagar – Gulmarg – Srinagar%After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed to Gulmarg. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel. Gulmarg, also known as the “Meadow of Flowers,” boasts a famous golf course during summer (one of the highest 18-hole golf courses in the world) and transforms into a ski resort during winter. Consider taking a gondola (cable car) ride from Gulmarg to Khilanmarg (additional cost) for breathtaking views of natural beauty in summer and full snowscapes in winter. Enjoy dinner and an overnight stay at your Srinagar hotel.
column12: Day 3 : Srinagar - Doodhpathri - Srinagar%Explore Doodhpathri, the “valley of milk,” located in Budgam district. This alpine valley is surrounded by snow-clad mountains. After a peaceful time at Doodhpathri, return to Srinagar for an overnight stay at the hotel.
column13: Day 4 : Srinagar - Yousmarg - Srinagar%Drive to Yousmarg, a captivating meadow situated at an elevation of 7,500 feet above sea level. Yousmarg is a cluster of meadows surrounded by magnificent trees in the lap of the Pir Panjal mountain range. Along the way, visit Dargah Charar Sharief. In Yousmarg, you can ride ponies in the meadows. Return to Srinagar for an overnight stay in a hotel.
column14: Day 5 : Srinagar - Pahalgam%After breakfast, leave the hotel and embark on a full-day excursion to Pahalgam, known as the “Village of Shepherds.” En route, visit the world-famous saffron growing fields, Awantipura ruins (9th century), and Martand Temple. Pahalgam is also famous for its Indian film industry connections, trekking routes, and as a base camp for the Amarnath pilgrimage. Enjoy dinner and an overnight stay at the hotel.
column15: Day 6 : Explore Pahalgam%Return to Srinagar%After breakfast, explore three valleys in Pahalgam: Betab Valley, Chandanwari, and Aru Valley (additional cost). Return to Srinagar in the evening for dinner and an overnight stay at the hotel.
column16: Day 7 : Srinagar – Gurez Valley%Drive to Gurez valley via Bandipora district in Jammu and Kashmir. The drive through the Himalayas offers incredible natural beauty. Visit Razdon top at an altitude of 11,672 feet, where you can see the highest peak of the Himalayas, Harmukh Peak. Check in to your hotel in Gurez valley, enjoy dinner, and prepare for an overnight stay.
column17: Day 8 : Gurez Local Sightseeing%Explore the nearby town of Dawar, where the local people (known as “Dards”) live in beautiful log wood houses. Observe their local lives and visit archaeological sites. Don’t miss the pyramid-shaped mountain peak, Habba Khatoon, named after the famous Kashmiri poetess. The crystal-clear spring flowing from the peak has medicinal properties. Capture the picturesque spring in photos before heading back to the hotel in the evening. Take your dinner and have a good sleep.
column18: Day 9 : Gurez to Srinagar%Begin the fourth day of your magical Gurez valley tour with a hearty breakfast. Get ready for a scenic drive towards Srinagar. Along the way, you’ll be treated to breathtaking views of nature. Consider making a stop at Izamrg village to explore the green meadows, take leisurely walks, and capture picturesque moments. Upon reaching Srinagar, check in to your houseboat for an overnight stay. Enjoy dinner and a peaceful night’s rest.
column19: Day 10 : Departure from Srinagar%After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed to Srinagar airport. Your tour comes to an end, but the sweet memories will remain with you. Safe travels!
